title: Parametric Multimodal User Memory: Storing What Captions Cannot Carry
abstract: arXiv:2608.28609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A personalized agent needs a user memory: a persistent model of who its user is. Today it is almost always text -- transcripts and captions retrieved by similarity. This serves the captionable half of a person ("my cat is named Bibi"), but discards the perceptual half no caption can hold: how a voice sounds, how a face reads across age and lighting, how tired someone sounds. We measure this loss across five modalities: a strong caption-based re-identifier recovers as little as 0.11 of a dedicated encoder's recall, collapsing toward chance on non-nameable signals.   We instead ground perceptual memory in the model, decomposing recall into two subproblems: a vision-language model grounds the referent in context (what and where), and a dedicated encoder extracts an identity key (who), stored as one inline token read by attention at generation with no external round-trip. Neither suffices alone -- the VLM identifies cross-age faces at only

translated_title: 参数化多模态用户记忆：存储描述文本无法承载的信息
translated_abstract: 个性化智能体需要一种用户记忆：即关于其用户的持久化模型。如今这种记忆几乎总是文本形式——通过相似度检索的转录文本和描述。这只能服务于一个人“可被描述”的那一半（例如“我的猫叫Bibi”），却丢弃了任何描述都无法承载的感知层面：一个人的声音听起来如何，一张脸在不同年龄和光照条件下的样貌，一个人声音中透出的疲惫程度。我们在五种模态上测量了这种损失：一个强大的基于描述的再识别方法最多只能恢复专用编码器0.11的召回率，在不可命名的信号上甚至跌至随机水平。我们转而将感知记忆植根于模型本身，将召回分解为两个子问题：视觉语言模型在上下文中定位指称对象（是什么、在哪里），专用编码器提取身份密钥（是谁），并将其存储为一个内联token，在生成时由注意力机制直接读取，无需外部往返调用。两者单独都不足以解决问题——视觉语言模型在识别跨年龄人脸时仅能达到……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出参数化多模态用户记忆方法，将感知身份信息以单个内联token的形式存储在模型中，克服了基于文本描述的记忆无法保留声音音色、跨年龄面部特征等不可命名感知信号的固有局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes parametric multimodal user memory that stores perceptual identity as a single inline token read by attention at generation, overcoming the fundamental limitation of caption-based memory which discards non-nameable perceptual signals such as voice timbre and cross-age facial appearance.
